## Overview

This dossier draws on the European Commission's Debt Sustainability Monitor published on 2026-02-12. The evidence covers Hungary's fiscal capacity, refinancing needs, and market signals. Key themes include a projected structural primary deficit, rising gross financing needs, and significant risks related to foreign currency debt and contingent liabilities. The European Commission classifies Hungary's long-term fiscal sustainability risk as high.

#### Other fiscal context

- **C3\*, context**: The European Commission projects a structural primary deficit of 0.9% of GDP as of 2026. This is low compared with past fiscal performance. Ageing-related expenditure is projected to increase. <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/debt-sustainability/Debt-Sustainability-Monitor-2025_2026-02-12, p. 202" aria-label="Source: ec/debt-sustainability/Debt-Sustainability-Monitor-2025_2026-02-12, p. 202">ⓘ</button>
- **C3\*, context**: The S2 indicator points to high risk, requiring a 6.7 percentage point improvement. The S1 indicator points to high risk, requiring a 5.3 percentage point effort. <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/debt-sustainability/Debt-Sustainability-Monitor-2025_2026-02-12, p. 203" aria-label="Source: ec/debt-sustainability/Debt-Sustainability-Monitor-2025_2026-02-12, p. 203">ⓘ</button>

#### Other refinancing context

- **R1\*, context**: Gross financing needs are expected to increase, reaching around 21% of GDP in 2036. <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/debt-sustainability/Debt-Sustainability-Monitor-2025_2026-02-12, p. 202" aria-label="Source: ec/debt-sustainability/Debt-Sustainability-Monitor-2025_2026-02-12, p. 202">ⓘ</button>
- **R1-A, context**: Significant proportion of foreign currency debt exposes the government to exchange rate risk. High exposure of domestic banks to government debt. Sizable amount of redeemable retail government bonds (approx. 20% of central government debt in 2024) poses refinancing risk. High level of contingent liabilities from state guarantees. <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/debt-sustainability/Debt-Sustainability-Monitor-2025_2026-02-12, p. 203" aria-label="Source: ec/debt-sustainability/Debt-Sustainability-Monitor-2025_2026-02-12, p. 203">ⓘ</button>
